home.heroTitle: Reliable solutions in freight, transport, and logistics
home.heroText: As Rotasyon Taşımacılık, we provide reliable, on-time, and solution-focused freight and logistics services across Türkiye. With operational discipline, field experience, and tailored planning, we deliver your cargo smoothly from pickup to delivery.
home.whyText: What sets logistics apart is not only the fleet, but planning quality, communication speed, and field discipline. At Rotasyon Taşımacılık, we manage every shipment as a measurable process that supports your business continuity.

timely.title: On-Time Delivery
timely.text: We plan operations based on route density, delivery windows, and field conditions. This makes arrival times predictable and helps keep your workflows uninterrupted.

safe.title: Secure Transport
safe.text: We apply regular checks during loading, transit, and delivery. Our professional field team and secure transport procedures prioritize the integrity of your cargo.

flexible.title: Flexible Solutions
flexible.text: We recommend the right model for LTL, FTL, or project-based shipments. We adapt quickly to changing volumes and help you run logistics more efficiently.

home.servicesText: At Rotasyon Taşımacılık we provide solutions for full truckload, partial load, intercity freight, and project logistics. We stand beside you as a reliable partner for both regular shipments and special projects.
home.servicesCta: Get a quote for this service

ftl.title: Full Truckload
ftl.text: We plan full truckload capacity specifically for large-volume shipments in a single run. We track the process transparently from departure to arrival and complete delivery with discipline.

ltl.title: Partial Load Transport
ltl.text: We offer cost-efficient partial load freight solutions for smaller shipments. Shared route planning helps us deliver both economically and on time.

project.title: Project Logistics
project.text: For oversized, heavy, or sensitive cargo, we plan together from site survey to vehicle selection. We build a measurable and secure transport plan for every project.

intercity.title: Intercity Transport
intercity.text: Through our nationwide network, we manage intercity freight and cargo shipments on regular lines. Route discipline is our priority for fast and consistent deliveries.

home.processText: We handle every transport request with a tailored operations plan. Clear communication throughout the process helps minimize surprises.

01.title: Request
01.text: Your shipment request is received; we quickly listen to your needs via WhatsApp or the form and guide you next.

02.title: Quote
02.text: Based on your cargo details we select the right vehicle and route, then share a clear and transparent quote.

03.title: Planning
03.text: The most efficient route is set; date, vehicle type, and delivery window are confirmed in writing.

04.title: Shipment
04.text: Your cargo leaves safely on the road and stays monitored across our nationwide operations network.

05.title: Delivery
05.text: At arrival we complete checks and handover, report the process, and stand ready for your next shipment.

home.ctaText: Share your shipment needs and we will quickly clarify the right route, vehicle, and schedule. Our professional team supports you from quote to delivery.

about.intro1: Rotasyon Taşımacılık is a freight and logistics brand that unites trust, speed, and transparency in one operational language. Our goal is not only to move cargo, but to bring order, predictability, and confidence to your supply chain.
about.intro2: By combining field experience with structured process management, we offer a wide range of services from intercity transport to project logistics. We value long-term partnerships and the same quality standard in every shipment.
about.ctaServices: Explore our freight and transport services
about.visionText: To become one of Türkiye's most trusted and preferred logistics brands, guiding the industry with technology-supported, measurable, and sustainable operations. Beyond short-term shipments, we aim to build a strong logistics infrastructure that grows with our clients.
about.missionText: To add value to our clients' workflows by delivering cargo on time, safely, and cost-effectively—completing every transport with the same quality standard. We create tailored solutions, keep communication clear, and manage operations transparently.
about.valuesText: The principles that shape our culture guide every decision—from field actions to client communication. These values help us deliver consistent, reliable, and solution-focused service in every project.

trust.title: Reliability
trust.text: We stand behind our word and take a transparent, accountable approach at every step of transport. The trust our clients place in us is the core measure of our operational quality.

time.title: Time Discipline
time.text: In logistics, a delay is more than lateness—it means cost and reputation risk across the chain. That is why we manage planning, field coordination, and delivery tracking with equal care.

customer.title: Customer Focus
customer.text: Every company's transport needs are different. Instead of one-size-fits-all packages, we create tailored solutions and strengthen partnerships through fast, clear communication.

growth.title: Continuous Improvement
growth.text: We regularly improve operations based on field feedback. Our goal is safer, more efficient, and more predictable logistics service.

about.approachText: We do not treat every transport request as a standard service. We evaluate cargo characteristics, delivery schedule, and operational risks together to build a plan for you. This means fewer surprises, clearer communication, and higher delivery quality. At Rotasyon Taşımacılık, our aim is not only to complete one shipment, but to remain your preferred trusted partner for the next one as well.
